name: rose

attributes.attribute: linked with love and loyalty in Celtic lands
place where rose spells drew love

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The rose is a symbolic plant. It is the fragrant flower of midsummer. People used the rose in divination and magic. In Celtic lands it stood for love and loyalty. People in the British Cotswolds used it in spells. Those spells drew a lover or kept a wandering heart from straying.

okr.objective: The rose is a symbolic plant tied to love and magic.
